about: Game key poses (tools/body/game_keys.py; read by correctives.py's "game_a" fold): A's and B's bones (skeleton space) in the same game shot, from --pose-probe-full dumps. Look = the look camera's shot (--new --step 1 --archetype reaver --zoom 0.45, idle_reaver_look), close = the town close camera (--zone waystation --quick reaver --close 1 --idle-after 1), day, frame 300 at 60 fps; A = heroine.glb shipped (P1 R1 round 11's A dumps), B = round_16 rest + chain v2 clips (R1 weights round 19's probe).
